title: Slow EBOM to MBOM assignment: ID in Context generation runs a full-MBOM query per element
product: Teamcenter / Active Workspace, Manufacturing BOM Management
users_affected: At least 4 of 5 sampled users (u2-u5); u1 not affected
summary: mbmAssignFromEbomToMbomCommand takes 5-30 minutes instead of 20-30 seconds for about 100-170 elements.
problem: Assigning elements from EBOM to MBOM via Active Workspace is slow for most users. Each assigned line runs ID in Context generation, which executes a query over the whole MBOM.
impact: Planners wait up to 30 minutes per assignment.

analysis.heading: IDIC callback present in every slow align call
analysis.text: USER_is_chain_needed_for_idic_generation runs in all 105 align calls of u4 /14 and in none of u1 /13.
analysis.excerpt: saveData3: aligns=105 total=1927s withIDIC=105 gapAfterIDIC=1911s avg(IDIC)=18.35s

analysis.heading: Per-line variance from database load
analysis.text: Same SQL_ID and plan hash run 2-18s per line across sessions.

steps: Open an MBOM with IDIC-bearing appearance path nodes in Active Workspace.
Select about 100 EBOM lines without ID in Context.
Run Assign from EBOM to MBOM.
questions: Is the full-MBOM query per assigned line expected behavior of IDIC generation?
